title: The Science Project
subtitle: 考点：同意与兴奋 / I agree with you.

dialogue.t: Ben, we must finish our science project on Friday.
I am worried. We have only two days.
Don't worry. I will make the poster and you can write the report.
I agree with you. Let's ask Mr Wang for help.
Good idea. We are both good at science.
Yes. I am excited about the project now!
Me too. We can finish it together.

vocab: project 项目 · finish 完成 · worried 担心的 · agree 同意 · both 两者都 · excited 兴奋的

questions.stem: When must they finish the project?
questions.why: We must finish our science project on Friday.

questions.stem: How does Ben feel at the end?
questions.why: I am excited about the project now!

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: They will ask Mr Wang for help.
questions.why: Let's ask Mr Wang for help.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: Lily and Ben are ____ good at science.
questions.why: We are both good at science.
